crossRefs.note: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.
But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.
But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.
who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify for himself a people for his own…
The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,
But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.
He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.
What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has…

translations.web: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.
translations.bsb: It is the same with you. Since you are eager to have spiritual gifts, strive to excel in gifts that build up the church.
translations.kjv: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.
translations.asv: So also ye, since ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may abound unto the edifying of the church.
